title: Export static site files
summary: A static export builds files that a static host can serve.
introduction: A static export builds files that a static host can serve. Your task: Find the exported HTML for the home and books routes.
learningObjectives: Find the exported HTML for the home and books routes.
Explain the example for export static site files

blocks.text: A static export builds files that a static host can serve. Browser interactions can still work without a runtime application server.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.

blocks.title: Export static site files

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `output: "export"` asks Next.js to make static files. Features needing a live Next.js server are outside that mode.

blocks.text: The out folder contains deployable static files for the supported routes.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Static export does not support features that need a live Next.js server. Use local build-time content for this course.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Find the exported HTML for the home and books routes.
